decision: Small offline diacritization is technically feasible; no model or native reader promoted from this diagnostic. Separate original text, ordinary Latin metadata and pronunciation.
inputs: 40fixed cases:16retainedCF/vocalization diagnostics plus24root-authored everyday/contrast/literal cases. Extension addsone22.3MB model to unchanged inputs after firsttwooutputs; not blind model selection.

review_notes: Ordinary vowel restoration is computationally cheap, but examples include فُنْدَق instead of فُنْدُق, تُفَضُّل instead of تُفَضِّل, مُحَطَّة instead of مَحَطَّة and defective آسْف.
An emoji is removed by upstream normalization. Arabic URL path letters receive marks. Existing supported vowel marks are constrained, but full literal preservation is not an application contract.
Many ordinary vowels are recovered, but arrival سأصل is given an extra shadda, نسيت is malformed, and flag علم is read as science.

The inspected mirror deliberately strips existing marks before inference; بُنًّا becomes بِنا. The original library has hint features; this capture does not evaluate those. Arabic URL text receives marks.

This fixed diagnostic improves several common words relative to both small alternatives: hotel, arrival, prefer, feeling, enjoyable and imperative write. This is an informed observation, not a neutral aggregate accuracy ranking.

Remaining examples include مُقْهَى for مَقْهَى, علم as science in an explicit flag-raising context, and inappropriate phone-adjective/gemination in بطارية هاتفي. Bare short forms and source person ambiguity remain.

Upstream strips supplied vowels (بُنًّا becomes بِنا), changes marks in Arabic URL paths and normalizes spacing/variants. Skeleton parity on these40 inputs is not byte-exact literal or source-mark preservation.

next_gates: Application overlay must retain exact original text, protected URLs/code/names/numbers/emoji and supplied Arabic marks; unmodified upstream output cannot be displayed or spoken as original.
Choose and qualify ordinary Latin conversion rather than exposing IPA; actual model vowels still require contextual review.
Source-aware authored lexical readings should take precedence. Common lexical ambiguity remains even with full Arabic sentence context.
Measure exact native runtime/package/latency and actual offline audio before any release. Host metrics do not measure native devices.
speech_caveat: Pinned eSpeak documentation restricts Arabic to fully diacritized text. Installed offline system voices are preferred by Android LocalVoice; bundled fallback existence/audio bytes alone do not establish unvocalized-Arabic pronunciation.
